11wbxt: Original SpanishCue material; the situations and data are for teaching purposes, not real news or official exam texts.
1biao6j: The employment office's brochure announced «la implementación de mecanismos de optimización de la intermediación». Several people read it without being able to explain what service was being offered. The office had not invented words or made grammatical errors. It had piled up abstract nouns until the main action was hidden: helping job seekers get in touch with companies. Administrative precision does not always coincide with clarity for the person who needs to use a service.
slsif4: A team reviewed the text with users of the center. It replaced some nominalizations with verbs and identified agents: «Una orientadora revisará tu experiencia y te ayudará a preparar una candidatura». It did not eliminate all technical terms. It kept intermediación in a section where it was defined and distinguished from training. Learning a new word can be useful if the context allows it to be understood; replacing it with a vague expression does not necessarily improve the text. The goal was to reduce obstacles, not to impoverish the content.
1b8ry2x: The review also detected unnatural collocations, such as «hacer una conclusión», and imprecise promises, such as «garantizamos mejorar tu futuro». The first was changed to sacar una conclusión; the second was reworded to describe actions the office could actually fulfill. A service can review a résumé and provide information, but cannot ensure that a company will hire every participant. The choice of words influences expectations and, therefore, the trust that an institution can sustain.
ydtnis: The new version was shorter, though not in every section. Explaining the difference between inscripción and selección required adding an example. That expansion kept people from interpreting their registration as automatic acceptance into a program. Clarity is not measured only by counting words: it also matters how many inferences the reader is asked to make. A precise text lets people act, distinguishes close concepts, and makes visible the limits of what it promises.

mqdb9: The office helps you prepare an application and learn about job openings. A counselor will review your experience, identify with you aspects you can improve, and agree on a next step. This service is called intermediación: it makes contact easier between job seekers and companies. It is not the same as training, although the counselor can inform you about courses if you need to develop a skill.
1oppmmv: To take part in a course, you must first register. Registration lets you enter the selection process, but does not guarantee a place. For example, you can submit your application today and later receive a request for documentation. Only when the selection ends will you know whether you have been admitted. The office will indicate the response deadline and the channel through which it will let you know the result.
1lif9x: Nor can we promise that a company will hire you. We can commit to reviewing your application and explaining the known conditions of an offer. The final decision is up to each company. If a condition is unclear, ask for clarification before sending additional information. Our goal is for you to be able to make a decision with enough data, not to create expectations about results that other people control.
